props.headline: You're building towards your first home
props.body: There's nothing to apply for yet. Here's roughly where you stand, and the one thing worth doing next.

slots.reason: Maya isn't ready to apply, so her screen opens by telling her where she is rather than asking her for something.
Saving a deposit is the thing Maya is actually doing, so her progress leads the screen.
Maya has never used the calculator, so it opens in its exploring mode — sliders and a range, not a figure that implies a decision.
The steps of buying a home, so the process stops feeling like one enormous decision.

props.headline: Give your deposit a boost
props.body: A Lifetime ISA adds 25% from the government to what you save, up to £1,000 a year.

slots.reason: The most useful next step for Maya moves her deposit along. It isn't an application.
Maya told us she doesn't know what to expect, so guidance sits high on her screen rather than at the bottom.

props.headline: Questions? Just ask
props.body: You don't have to be ready to apply to talk to someone.

slots.reason: Available, but quiet — Maya hasn't asked for help and shouldn't feel pushed towards a conversation.
